commit_message: Revamp the TableAreaSettingsPopup layout and styling for a cleaner, more compact UI. Switched card background to white and simplified header spacing/icon sizes; reduced paddings and adjusted button sizes. Reworked notation, precision and options sections (smaller controls, clearer labels, switch for alignment) and tightened the live preview table (sticky header, updated column labels and monospace formatting). Minor copy clarifications for notation descriptions and button styling tweaks for a subtler action appearance.
